head: hex, TR headmark, grade 5
notes: Dr Rebuild repro of GM 9418821 or 122126 (spare tire lock bracket), zinc plated repro; original finish not stated. An NSN listing (parttarget) describes it as hex head cap screw, thread class 2A, thread length ~0.81-0.88 in (not fetched).

sources.title: 1963-1982 Corvette Spare Tire Lock Bolt Bracket Mount TR Bolt Set Repro Of GM 9418821 or 122126 - Dr Rebuild
sources.quote: Set includes two grade 5 TR head mark 3/8-16x1 inch Zinc plated bolts & two split lock washers.
